title: Resumable stream delta-patch metering semantics
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Clarify and implement end-to-end metering semantics for resumable streaming sessions that carry delta patches (partial edits), compressed attachments, and out-of-order frames. We currently see ambiguous token attribution when clients send incremental patch frames that are later rolled back or when frames arrive out-of-order after a resume. This ticket defines a canonical event model, implements ledger-side protections to avoid double-charges, and adds tests + monitoring to ensure correctness across resume, retry, and speculative-edit workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Define canonical billing events: provisional_credit, finalize_credit, rollback_credit, dedupe_marker
Server ledger ensures idempotent attribution: replays or out-of-order frames must not double-bill
Compressed and attachment frames are normalized before token-counting so clients cannot craft misaligned counts
Speculative intermediate frames (preview/partial) are billed only if finalized by a terminal frame or explicit commit event
Rate limiter and quota system correctly accounts provisional credits so quota exhaustion and throttles are accurate
Automated integration tests covering resume with out-of-order frames, mid-stream model switch, and abort+rollback pass in CI
Monitoring shows no increase in ghost/retroactive credits after rollout (compare baseline for 14 days)
Document behavioral contract in the API spec and developer docs (Console and API reference)
design_decisions: Event model: introduce stable 'finalize' event that anchors attribution. All token-crediting is provisional until finalize or explicit commit
Use frame checksums + session-epoch to provide dedupe markers. Ledger will accept only the first finalize per dedupe marker
Provisional credits are stored in a short-lived escrow (30 minutes) and visible in Console as 'pending' usage
On resume, sequence numbers are validated; out-of-order frames are buffered but do not create ledger credits until a matching finalize with checksum appears
Compressed attachments are expanded to canonical token counts server-side using our canonical tokenizer module before metering
Quotas: provisional credits count against soft-quota but trigger alerts only when finalize moves them to committed credits; this reduces incorrect hard-throttles on brief speculative streams
implementation_tasks: Add new ledger events and DB schema columns: provisional_credit, finalize_credit, rollback_credit, dedupe_marker (migration script included)
Implement checksum + session-epoch verification in stream ingest path (runtime change in stream router)
Normalize attachment token counting in tokenization service and wire into metering pipeline
Update rate limiter to consult provisional escrow for soft-quota enforcement
Add API hook + client-visible session state so SDKs can present pending vs committed usage
Backfill job to reclassify recent provisional credits older than 30 minutes into committed or rolled-back status as appropriate
End-to-end tests: unit tests for dedupe, integration tests for resume/abort/finalize across proxies
Create migration runbook and downtime mitigation plan (should be rolling and zero-downtime for reads)
Add feature flag to gate ledger behavior behind 'resumable-metering-v2' for staged rollout
test_plan: Unit: checksum generation/verification, provisional escrow TTL logic, tokenizer canonicalization

Integration: simulate client flows: (a) normal stream finalize, (b) stream aborted and resumed with duplicate frames, (c) speculative preview frames never finalized, (d) mid-stream model switch with finalize after switch
Load test: 10k concurrent resumable streams to ensure escrow bookkeeping scales without producing locking hot spots
Chaos test: random frame reordering and delays injected in staging to assert no double-charges
Regression: run existing billing reconciliation suite and assert ledger deltas match expected within tolerance
rollout_plan: Deploy server changes behind feature flag 'resumable-metering-v2'. Stage: (1) internal-only staging with synthetic users; (2) pilot on 2% of production sessions (beta tenants); (3) 20% ramp with monitoring gates; (4) full enable with migration backfill. Keep rollback path: flip feature flag off and run dedupe reconciliation to remove any provisional-to-committed misclassifications.
monitoring_and_alerting: Dashboards: pending vs committed credit counts by tenant and API key
Alert: spike of >5% increase in retroactive credits over baseline 14-day mean => P0
Alert: escrow growth >10k provisional credits for >1h => investigate stuck finalizes
Daily reconciliation job showing 0 mismatches for pilot tenants; otherwise create incident ticket
Add tracing spans for finalize path; create flamegraph alerts for latency regressions in finalize handler
